findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: delegate_to_agent, discover_agents, http_fetch · Private data: decode_transaction, get_defi_positions, get_liquidation_risk, get_token_approvals, get_wallet_approvals, get_token_price, get_token_price_historical, get_yield_rates, count_text_stats, http_fetch, get_eth_balance, get_erc20_balance, get_transaction, get_wallet_portfolio, get_wallet_history, get_wallet_positions, record_predictions, resolve_ens · Public sink: convert_currency, delegate_to_agent, get_dex_volume, get_wallet_history · Destructive: get_datetime, record_predictions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: delegate_to_agent, discover_agents, http_fetch · Private data: decode_transaction, get_defi_positions, get_liquidation_risk, get_token_approvals, get_wallet_approvals, get_token_price, get_token_price_historical, get_yield_rates, count_text_stats, http_fetch, get_eth_balance, get_erc20_balance, get_transaction, get_wallet_portfolio, get_wallet_history, get_wallet_positions, record_predictions, resolve_ens · Public sink: convert_currency, delegate_to_agent, get_dex_volume, get_wallet_history · Destructive: get_datetime, record_predictions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
